sources.snippet: Paper | Jax Code π0 (Pi-Zero) is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model, developed by the Physical Intelligence team designed for generalist robot control. It builds upon large-scale pretraining and flow matching-based action generation, enabling robots to perform dexterous manipulation tasks across different embodiments. π0 is trained on data from 7 robotic platforms and 68 unique tasks ...
